## English

This directory contains the Log-structured File System implementation.

`config.mk` records 11 source file(s) here: `lfs_alloc.c`, `lfs_balloc.c`, `lfs_bio.c`, `lfs_cksum.c`, `lfs_debug.c`, `lfs_inode.c`, `lfs_segment.c`, `lfs_subr.c`, `lfs_syscalls.c`, `lfs_vfsops.c`, `lfs_vnops.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
